assertions.assertion: The web_app client has AccessTokenType = AccessTokenType.Reference
The web_app client has AccessTokenLifetime set to 900 (15 minutes)
The ApiResource api1_resource has ApiSecrets with at least one Secret configured

Explains that JWT access tokens cannot be revoked (RFC 7009 revocation applies only to reference access tokens and refresh tokens), which is why reference tokens are used here for immediate revocation
assertions.rationale: Describes revocation for reference tokens but never says JWT access tokens cannot be revoked or contrasts with JWTs/RFC 7009.
